title: Number Of Rectangles That Can Form The Largest Square
description:
You are given an array of rectangles, where rectangles[i] = [li, wi] represents the length and width of the ith rectangle. You can form a square from a rectangle whose side length is min(li, wi). Return the number of rectangles that can form a square with the maximum possible side length.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: rectangles = [[5,8],[3,9],[5,12],[16,5]]
Output: 3
```

The largest square side lengths are [5,3,5,5], so three rectangles form a largest square.

### Example 2

```text
Input: rectangles = [[2,3],[3,7],[4,3],[3,7]]
Output: 3
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= rectangles.length <= 1000
- rectangles[i].length == 2
- 1 <= li, wi <= 10^9
- li != wi
